item.title: RBI to conduct Overnight Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction under LAF on September 16, 2026
item.description:
On a review of current and evolving liquidity conditions, it has been decided to conduct a Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auction on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, as under:

Sl. No. Notified Amount
(₹ crore)		 Tenor (day) Window Timing Date of Reversal
1 2,50,000 1 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM September 17, 2026
(Thursday)

2. The operational guidelines for the auction as given in the Reserve Bank’s Press Release 2019-2020/1947 dated February 13, 2020 will remain the same.

Ajit Prasad          
Deputy General Manager
(Communications)
